body.x: Switzerland Global Enterprise (S-GE), the Swiss government agency for export and investment publicity, will present 24 Swiss start-ups with their newest innovations at CES 2023 in Las Vegas on January 5-8, 2023. Switzerland will highlight these companies' high-tech research capabilities in VR, AR, wearables, disability technologies, and more. Visitors can find the swisstech pavilion at booth #61344 at the Venetian, Eureka Park, Level 1, Hall G.
Among 24 companies participating in the booth, S-GE spotlighted three companies in the pavilion:

Nanoleq/Oxa will show Oxa Life, the wearable linked with a biofeedback application that measures respiration to detect stress and other health problems and then warns the user. Oxa Life guides users on maintaining a more nutritious and stabilized lifestyle via breathing workouts.

nobank will present a cost-saving solution to digital asset transactions by creating a non-custodial, smart-contract wallet with security and social recovery. nobank allows users to trade or invest cryptocurrency and NFT directly on the blockchain, according to principles of self-ownership and practical peer-to-peer transactions. It promises users control over their assets without an intermediary.

AVAtronics will demonstrate the first AI wideband ANC technology capable of canceling noise without damaging the audio quality. The new AVA Active Noise Cancellation ANC solution is patent-protected technology - applicable in platforms like audio SoCs, FPGAs, and DSPs.
